outputs.with:
Subject: Rain plan for our community garden exchange

Because rain is expected, the seed swap will take place indoors at the market on May 4 instead of outdoors. Moving inside keeps envelopes dry and gives growers plenty of table space to browse. Please bring one packet from your shelf to contribute and trade with fellow gardeners.
